name: Nested-Halfspace Margin Bound
statement: If a pc-minor has $h$ nested coordinate halfspaces, then $\mu(C)\le U_h=2/(h+\sqrt{h^2+4(h-1)})\le1/h$. For the threshold path $T_h$, $1/(2h-1)\le\mu(T_h)\le U_h$ although every minimal missing support has size two.
proof: Two endpoint witnesses and the chain of adjacent missing-pattern rows give a tridiagonal system. Positivity of its determinant yields the upper bound; uniform half-half rows and explicit geometric witnesses give the threshold lower bound.
